The redirector's log lines are now level-queryable JSON in the tier's OpenObserve `modal_logs` stream (mngr-internal#656): the Modal function calls the shared `configure_logging()` before `init_sentry`, so each line is one JSON object with an explicit `level`. Previously the container had no root log handler, so its warnings reached the logs as bare messages. The entrypoint's misconfiguration warning now logs under `imbue.oauth_redirector.app` rather than `app` (Modal mounts `app.py` as module `app`, so a `__name__` logger sits outside the `imbue.*` subtree the bootstrap configures).
